mapper.select: /* GroupQueryMapper.findGroupMemberList */ SELECT gm.id AS id, gm.group_id AS groupId, gm.user_no AS userNo, u.sp_user_id AS spUserId, gm.stdt_id AS stdtId, gm.member_type AS memberType, gm.member_no AS memberNo, gm.status AS status, gm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM group_member gm LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_no = gm.user_no WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gm.member_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* GroupQueryMapper.findGroupDetail */ SELECT gi.group_id AS groupId, gi.cla_id AS claId, gi.host_user_no AS hostUserNo, gi.group_nm AS groupNm, gi.group_desc AS groupDesc, gi.school_level AS schoolLevel, gi.grade AS grade, gi.class_number AS classNumber, gi.school_name AS schoolName, gi.school_code AS schoolCode, gi.invite_code AS inviteCode, gi.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, gi.use_yn AS useYn, gi.created_at AS createdAt, u.sp_user_id AS hostSpUserId, CASE WHEN gi.host_user_no = #{userNo} THEN 'HOST' ELSE 'STUDENT' END AS myRole FROM group_info gi JOIN `user` u ON u.user_no = gi.host_user_no WHERE gi.group_id = #{groupId}
/* GroupQueryMapper.findActiveDgnssId */ SELECT id FROM tb_dgnss_info WHERE cla_id = #{claId} AND dgnss_at = 'Y' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

/* GroupQueryMapper.findAdminGroupDetail */ SELECT gi.group_id AS groupId, gi.cla_id AS claId, gi.group_nm AS groupNm, gi.group_desc AS groupDesc, gi.school_name AS schoolName, CASE WHEN gi.school_level = 'elementary' THEN '초등' WHEN gi.school_level = 'middle' THEN '중등' WHEN gi.school_level = 'high' THEN '고등' ELSE '' END AS schoolLevelNm, gi.grade AS grade, gi.class_number AS classNumber, gi.invite_code AS inviteCode, gi.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, gi.use_yn AS useYn, gi.created_at AS createdAt, u.sp_user_id AS hostSpUserId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = gi.group_id AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeMemberCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = gi.group_id) AS totalMemberCount FROM group_info gi JOIN `user` u ON u.user_no = gi.host_user_no WHERE gi.group_id = #{groupId}
